actual_widget.method: Owned paused headless real renderers, no native jobs or providers. Startup and table loading excluded. Each trial sums eight edit-to-ack and edit-to-applied segments. Applied observation includes projected RPC/long-poll/Python/socket overhead. Every complete frame hash matches across variants/trials; independent edited text, full retained rows, last text and empty UI errors checked outside timing. Two excluded warmup trials, seeded shuffled pairs, warm filesystem, serial measurement without builds/stress. Not event-to-photon, cold start, RSS or Linux timing.
actual_widget.cleanup: all owned servers stopped, reaped with status zero and temporary workspaces removed

fresh_CLI_controls.method: Same sources, cwd, arguments, inherited environment and catalog across preserved release binaries. Five warmups and shuffled interleaved fresh-process trials; exact successful status and empty stdout/stderr checked. Identical resolved explain plans verified outside timing. No applet executes. Includes CLI startup, parsing, static validation and known-input preflight. Warm filesystem caches, uncontrolled host background activity. Run without concurrent builds/stress; not native command execution, cold-cache, Linux/Windows or universal Bash evidence.

verification.legacy_handoff: 180 exact transitions compare full UI, complete frame, generation, focus, queues and sanitized lists; includes saturated queues, changed/unchanged/removed ports and u64 generation wrapping
verification.complete_frame_oracles: all actual widget frames identical across both binaries/trials/repeats for each table size; independent exact rows/text/errors/clean child exit also passed
verification.Windows_cross_compile: x64 and ARM64 alltargets passed; compile only locally
verification.WASM: byte-identical, receipt refreshed normally; no new browser timing/visual claim
verification.docs: 5 documentation tests and links in33 maintained files passed

interpretation: Three alternating private handoff rounds: 4 MiB table 1.346 to 0.372 ms (-72.35%); 64 KiB table -68.32%; chart -62.59%; list256 -34.94%; unchanged64KiBport -55.4%; small control -9.39%.

The private handoff excludes parsed screen, typed state construction, per-batch typed input clones and all output checking. It consumes owned inputs and includes replacement/temporary destruction, without decoding, validation, publication, rendering, IPC or native jobs. Not whole-widget latency or memory usage.

Two 20-trial real renderer runs: 4 MiB edit-to-applied medians -5.87% and -6.19%. Each trial sums eight individual edits; acknowledgement medians +1.05%/+1.08%. Small cases within1.5%. Includes projected RPC, scheduling and Python/socket observation, not event-to-photon latency.

Tradeoff: unchanged list256 manifest validation control is consistently +7.81%/+8.48%, about498 to539ns. Unchanged cron microcontrol -11.4%/-13.1%. Cause not established; build/code-layout effects are a possibility, not a verified explanation or an attributed gain.

Five fresh CLI static-check controls,120samples/variant each, all within0.5%, with identical explain plans and exact status/stdout/stderr. Native runtime API controls -0.4%..+2.6%, retained without claiming improvement.

Native executable 2886288 to2886176 bytes (-112). Allocations, peak memory, RSS, cold filesystem/startup and Linux performance were not measured. No universal Bash/provider/production-completeness claim.
